decision: Keep the missing-pin doctor note as a proceed warning; do not promote it to error

governingRule.description: Expected #3: choose one. warning cannot change doctor exit. error retro-fails pre-pin consumers.

alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Changes doctor exit via errorCount and retro-fails every pre-pin consumer.
Opposite polarity: that set demotes a fail to a warning.

whyWinner: Doctor exit is errorCount-only. The reconstitution gap is closed by writing the pin on greenfield. Existing pre-pin consumers keep a proceed warning.
revisitTrigger: If a consumer-facing gate starts treating the missing-pin note as blocking.
